lines: "The Force is in the sand as much as in you. On Dagobah there is a cave that shows what you fear. On Ilum, a temple that asks what you are. Go and find out."
notes: Act 1. Sets the flag the Dagobah and Ilum scenes quote.

yaml_name: Tusken scout watching from the rocks
lines: "Rrraaagh!" / "...the hermit is under the clan's protection."
notes: RAIDER class (net:trainer-class-raider). Band 7-9.

lines: "Kenobi's apprentice. Then you will do." / "...he is still out there. Good."
notes: New object on the path, shown with flag:sys-game-clear until the flag is set (net:maul-duel). Never catchable. Ben gives a SITH SHARD after.

lines: "Sit. The desert teaches patience; I have had years of lessons."
"Power converters. You want them, you wait like everyone else."
notes: Fixer runs Tosche Station in Act 1 and digs Beggar's Canyon later (npc:rusturf-tunnel:1).

lines: "Camie says Luke is off chasing another COMPANION. That boy."
"Meesa Jar Jar! Yousa going to Kashyyyk? Big trees. Bigger Wookiees."
notes: Jar Jar stop 1 (var:unused-0x4091 = 0). New object by the depot.

lines: "Move along. Move along."
notes: Sandtrooper (desert cloak) at the station gate, one of two. New objects; walker net:walker-sandtrooper.

lines: "We are looking for two droids. Seen any?"
notes: Second sandtrooper.

lines: "Docking Bay 94 is closed for an inspection. Imperial business."
notes: Sandtrooper by the docking bay. New object; walker net:walker-sandtrooper.

lines: "That Corellian freighter again. One day we will search it properly."
notes: Second sandtrooper at Mos Eisley.

lines: "Chewie is at the ship. Me, I am here until someone buys a round."
notes: Han in his booth whenever he is not flying the player (after Act 2). New object; net:mos-eisley-cantina.

lines: "Odds on Sebulba: nobody takes them. Odds on anyone else: nobody takes them either."
"Bzzt. Engine three is on fire. That is normal."
"The Boonta Eve runs over the old Cycling Road. Hover-bikes only, now."
"You race? No. You lose. Sebulba wins. Always." / "Chuba! ...take the lens. Sebulba does not need to see you again."
notes: SWOOP RACER boss after flag:badge03-get (net:podrace-sebulba). Gives a SCOPE LENS. New object in the pit lane.

lines: "Nobody sees Jabba without an invitation. You have one? No?"
"The last visitor went down the trapdoor. Want to see it?"
"Jabba pays well. The ones who fail him pay better."
"Skiff duty tomorrow. Over the Dune Sea. I hate the Dune Sea."
"I was sent for spice. I got lost. I am always lost."
notes: Bib Fortuna's errand: talk to the droid, it goes back inside; Bib gives a RARE CANDY (net:jabbas-palace).

lines: "Utinni! ...Jabba buys droids. Jabba does not pay for droids."
"Bossk waits. Jabba has a job on Endor for someone with teeth."
notes: Bossk before the Endor Station raid (badge 4 to 5).

lines: "Ho ho ho. A small one with pods. The sea titan will not fit in a pod, little one."
notes: Lines only; Jabba is beaten at the Hutt Hideout.

lines: "De wanna wanga... my errand droid is lost again. Find it and I forget you were here."
"Hrrrnk."
"Hrrrnk! Hrrrnk!"
"Hee hee hee hee!"
"He is only hungry. Step on the grate and you will see how hungry."
notes: The rancor keeper by the trapdoor (new object). The pit is a fixed battle with a level 23 RANCOR that cannot be caught; after it he opens the chest: KING'S ROCK.
Fixed battle under the trapdoor (net:jabbas-palace). Pod refused.

lines: "The sail barge does not leave. Neither do you, until we have fought."
"The Khetanna. Jabba has never sailed her past the pit. One day."
"Yousa made it! Meesa going to Sullust next. Hot. Very hot."
notes: Jar Jar stop 2 (var = 1). New object by the hangar.

lines: "Rrrawrgh. (The elder points up: the village has stood in these branches for a thousand years.)"
"Rrrrrgh!" (a challenge)
"Wrrhhh." (a quieter challenge)
"Rrr! (The cub wants to show you a seed it found.)"
"Hrrrnnn. (The chief hands you a disc.) TM31 BRICK BREAK."
notes: Gives TM31 once (net:rwookrrorro).

lines: "Rrawr. (The elder says the Empire takes Wookiees from the lowlands. Not from here. Not yet.)"
"Hrrrrraaugh! (Chewbacca is glad to be home. He says Han owes him a holiday.)"
notes: Shown whenever the Falcon is docked (Han not flying). New object.

lines: "Hrrn. (The bowcaster maker will trade his WROSEED for any TATOOINE companion.)"
notes: In-game trade: WROSEED for a TATOOINE species (net:rwookrrorro).

lines: "Rrrr. (The weaver shows you a Life Day robe.)"
"I fly for anyone who pays and the Rebellion when nobody does. Dr. Tien's rock? The Empire took it an hour ago."
notes: Takes over the gentleman NPC in Inyusu Tor (Fallarbor).

lines: "Da hot springs! Meesa stayed in too long. Endor next, with da little bears."
notes: Jar Jar stop 3 (var = 2). New object by the hot springs.

lines: "This is a restricted area. Drill time."
"The general says we train until the lava cools. It never cools."
"Lord Vader wants soldiers who do not flinch at fire. You are not one of mine. Leave."
notes: Veers drills the troops here; fought on Mustafar Peak and in Fortress Vader (Emerald's Tabitha).

lines: "Collector arm four: jammed. Since the war. Nobody fixes anything."
"The old Separatist records are sealed. You will not see them. ...you saw them."
"The holo-table plays the same seconds over and over. Two men. A river of fire."
"A Separatist holocron, cracked. A voice: '...the Jedi are the true enemy, my young friend...' Count Dooku, dead these twenty years."
notes: A sign-like object on the console (new). Dooku appears only as this relic.

lines: "The walkers went down a month ago. Command has not sent a pickup."
"Logs. On ropes. In trees. Nobody briefed us on logs."
"Yub nub! (The scout mimes a log swinging and a walker falling.)"
"Captain Rex. Clone, retired, un-retired. I need what is in that bunker. Clear it and the elixir is yours."
notes: Rex on Endor (canon: Rebels; a clone alongside the Rebellion in 2 BBY). Gives a MAX ELIXIR after the bunker straggler is beaten.

lines: "Last one on guard. The scanner table stays. ...fine, take the scanner table."
"Da little bears like Jar Jar! Yousa going up to da cloud city? Meesa first."
notes: Jar Jar stop 4 (var = 3). New object on a platform.

lines: "...(Lobot blinks.) The north skybridge is open to you. The refinery has visitors it did not invite."
notes: Takes over the elder NPC in Cloud City (Lilycove). Gives a SMOKE BALL once the refinery is cleared (net:tibanna-refinery).

lines: "So high! Jar Jar no look down. Dagobah next. Swampy. Like home."
notes: Jar Jar stop 5 (var = 4). New object on the landing platform.

lines: "Snrk. Thugs at the tanks. We are workers, not fighters. You look like a fighter."
"Tibanna gas sells for more than spice this year. Jabba wants it all."
"The bald guy with the headset keeps watching us. Creepy."
"The siphon is on tank six. He is on tank six too."
"Last tank. Last thug. Let us make this quick."
"The freezing rig is new. Carbon. The baron wants it tested on something big. Not on me."
"The kyber is not ours. We only keep it. Someone has forgotten that."
"Pilgrims cross the holy waters from the pad. Troopers do not bother; they fly."
"I walked from the pad. The water was cold. I am happy."
"Kyber shipments are Imperial property. So is this street."
"Crystals, light or dark. I do not ask what you do with them."
notes: Shop: KYBER CRYSTAL and SITH SHARD at Pirin's price (net:nijedha).

lines: "I am one with the Force and the Force is with me. You? You are with your companions. Close enough. Take this spoon; it bends."
notes: Gives a TWISTEDSPOON once the temple summit scene is done.

lines: "He talks. I shoot. Today nobody shoots. Enjoy it."
"Chirrut says the temple will fall within the decade. Baze says he says that every decade."
"The hostel floor is stone. My knees are old. The Force is patient; I am not."
"Beds are free for pilgrims. You are a pilgrim now."
"Major Derlin. One of my scouts walked north and did not walk back. Find him and the general will hear of it."
notes: Derlin leads the field team; Rieekan is in the outpost.

lines: "They smell worse inside than out. Still beats walking."
"Cal Alder. Survey team. The cold keeps you honest."
"Toryn Farr. If the general picks this rock for a base, I want a transfer."
"Tigran Jamiro. There is something in the cave with claws. We named it after the scream it makes."
"...I saw it. White. Tall. I am not going back in there. Take this; I will not need ice to remember."
notes: Gives a NEVER-MELT ICE and walks back to camp (net:hoth-survey).

lines: "General Rieekan. You brought my scout home. If this planet becomes our base, I will remember who walked it first. TM07, for the weather."
notes: Gives TM07 HAIL after the lost scout is found.

lines: "Shield generator survey. Power survey. Where-to-put-the-door survey. Hoth has a lot of nothing to survey."
"Two tauntauns and a cold. The cold is winning."
"The Empire ended the contract. The pods are dark. One subject was never recorded. It left on its own. We call it the prototype."
notes: PROTOCLONE's story (Mewtwo's slot; still unobtainable).

lines: "Cadet. The commander says the drill is the drill. Begin."
"Last batch. No more after us. Make it count."
"Commander Cody. Was. The Empire has no use for old clones, so I keep the last cadets sharp. You beat them. Take this band; it held my helmet on at Utapau."
notes: New object by the pods. Gives a FOCUS BAND after both cadets are beaten (net:kamino-cloning-hall).

lines: "Wedge Antilles. Red Two, when there is a Red Squadron. The tower has a shuttle for anywhere the Rebellion needs eyes."
"Wes Janson. I fly with Wedge. I also keep Wedge from flying into things."
"Hobbie Klivian. Shuttle duty today: Hoth, Kamino, and wherever the swamp pilot refuses to go."
"Zev Senesca. Fuel count is low. The Empire knows it too."
"Dak Ralter. Youngest pilot on the base. I feel like I could take on the whole Empire myself."
"Last stop for Jar Jar. Yousa go on. Take dis: a pearl from Otoh Gunga. Meesa going home."
notes: Jar Jar stop 6 (var = 5): gives a BIG PEARL and leaves (var = 6).

lines: "A clatter of four arms and a cough. 'General Kenobi... you are a bold one.' Then nothing. The cave shows what the Jedi feared."
notes: New object (a shimmer) in the Cave of Evil. Grievous appears only as this vision.

lines: "You should not be able to see me. Then again, I should not be here. Mortis keeps what the Force sends it. Go carefully."
notes: Ahsoka at the Mortis Gate (canon: between Malachor, 3 BBY, and her return, 1 BBY, she is in the World Between Worlds; Mortis is where that road begins). New object; lines only, never fought.

lines: "Oh! A visitor for the Senator. I am C-3PO, human-cyborg relations. Do mind the StarNAV prototypes; they are frightfully fragile."
notes: Takes over the employee NPC beside Sen. Organa. Never a companion (owner, 2026-11-03).

lines: "Bwee-oop! (The astromech is plugged into the StarNAV bench. It sounds pleased with itself.)"
notes: Takes over the StarNAV scientist slot. Never a companion (owner, 2026-11-03).

lines: "Captain Piett. This deck is secure. ...it was secure."
"K-2SO. Reprogrammed Imperial droid. The odds of you reaching the command deck are low. I will say them out loud as we go."
notes: Canon: Cassian's droid by 2 BBY (Andor); here on his own mission.

lines: "Deck 1. Nobody comes up here without a code."
"The scaffolds are not rated for a fight. We fight anyway."
"Admiral Motti. This station will be the ultimate power in the galaxy. You are a rounding error."
"Deck 2. Nobody comes up here without a code."
"The scaffolds are not rated for a fight. We fight anyway."
"General Tagge. Construction is behind schedule. You are not helping."
"Deck 3. Nobody comes up here without a code."
"The scaffolds are not rated for a fight. We fight anyway."
"Admiral Ozzel. Clumsy of you to come this far. Clumsier of me to let you."
"Deck 4. Nobody comes up here without a code."
"The scaffolds are not rated for a fight. We fight anyway."
"Captain Needa. I take full responsibility for this deck. Apparently that means fighting you."
"Colonel Yularen's staff. No further."
"The Director is in conference. With the Emperor. You will wait. ...you will not wait."
"First trooper on the station. Last one you meet."
"Director Krennic. We stand here amidst my achievement, not yours. ...get out. Before Lord Vader hears of this."
notes: The final battle of the Death Star site (net:death-star-site). Sets flag:unused-0x025.

lines: "(A hologram, hooded.) 'Director. The station will be ready. See that it is.' The image flickers out before it notices you."
notes: Palpatine as a hologram only, never fought (owner, 2026-11-03). New object on the command deck.

notes: Stall by the crossroads market.

notes: By Doran's starfighter on its pad.

lines: "Another burnt-out power converter. Out here the sand gets into everything."
"Luke's always racing skyhoppers through BEGGAR'S CANYON. One day he'll fly right into a wall."
notes: Camie in town; vanilla Wanda stays in her house and the tunnel too.
